_comment: Questions people ask the knowledge base (the dashboard's Ask), with their intent, to train System 1's intent question (docs/SYSTEM1_PLAN.md, J5). who = who knows or worked on something; history = has it happened before, which bugs; latest = the newest bug, change or ticket; how = how something works or why it behaves so; where = where in the code; other = anything else. Written, plus the questions asked on the dashboard so far and the examples of agent.config.json.
